falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5% above or at least 5% below its level on the verdict date within the next 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive directional move occurred, so HOLD/UNKNOWN was the wrong call — the tape resolved and a directional signal was required

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70, or at or below 15, on any tracked session in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The neutral 38 reading was not a stable regime; the score left the indecision band and invalidated an UNKNOWN verdict

falsification_conditions.condition: Similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 50% while similarity to any other named pattern in the engine rises above 70%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% bottom_2024_aug analog that justified withholding a verdict broke, and a competing pattern became the dominant match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
